scenes.say: This was just checked, with our server switched off. Nothing was contacted.

card.title: Proof that doesn't need you to trust us.

scenes.say: When an automated client reads your site, and hands what it found to another one, the strongest thing you can usually say is that the two of them look similar.

card.label: the strongest thing a site operator can say today

scenes.say: Canary Maze gives every automated visitor its own secret URL, then records who else comes asking for it. Every sentence on this page is computed from the records.
A URL only context A was ever shown was requested by context B. Different user agent, different network. This one is a seeded replay, and the page says so on its own face.
The secret is that marked string, there, in context B's request. Context A was only ever shown it.

callout.text: issued to A · fetched by B

scenes.say: Now the part that matters. This recomputes every hash in your own browser, from the bundle alone. Verified. Five hashes, with crypto.subtle, and no request to our server at all.
A sighting shows a secret moved between two contexts. Not that there are two operators. We measured that on the AI Village corpus, and every single agent in it presents more than one context.

card.label: agents present more than one session context · 78,362 sessions analysed · busiest agent: 7,465

scenes.say: Organic sightings: zero, and reported as zero. Humans are turned away by the gate, so they never enter the ledger at all.
Canary Maze. The record checks out without trusting the recorder.
